name: turn
title: CNC Turning
hint: Sketch the half section of the part on the XZ plane: X is the radius, Z runs along the axis, and the end to be faced is at the highest Z. The tool starts at the front and cuts toward the chuck. Depth per pass is the radial depth of each roughing cut. Tool nose radius is not compensated: leave the allowance for it. Post the program for Mach3 or LinuxCNC; X is written as a diameter.

title: Untrim
hint: Pick a trimmed surface or face. 'Natural surface' removes every trim and gives back the full patch it was cut from; 'Fill the holes' keeps the outer outline and closes the cut-outs. Planes and other endless surfaces only offer the second.

name: warp
title: Warp
hint: Pick bodies, surfaces, curves, forms or meshes, then choose Bend, Twist, Taper or Stretch along an axis. The part of the shape before the start stays put and the part beyond the end moves rigidly with it. Higher smoothness gives solids and surfaces more control points to follow a strong bend.
